annotations.title: Get the fix files for a site

description: The files that fix what the newest scan of one of the user's sites found (paid plans): llms.txt when the site has none, a robots.txt that lets the blocked AI crawlers in, and a checklist of the changes that need a code change. Returns each file with its path and content, and the steps to add them to the project. Use it when the user asks you to apply the whywontai fixes to their code. The same files go into the whywontai GitHub pull request; this tool is for a site with no GitHub connection or for a user who wants their own agent to make the change.
name: get_fix_files
title: Get the fix files for a site
